reviews.text: Laura László pulled out 5 of my cat's teeth, leaving the roots in, practically just breaking the crowns. This caused the cat so much pain that it could neither eat nor drink, it just vomited. I took it back twice, but neither Laura László nor Sándor Méhes had any idea what could be wrong with the animal and they let it dry out. I paid them 113 thousand forints, then another 800 thousand forints elsewhere to save the animal. My cat has demonstrably suffered permanent health damage because of them. After all this, they didn't even apologize.

I am 100% satisfied. I can only recommend them. They are very animal friendly. 👍👍👍

Thanks in advance to Dr. Gabriella Szűcs, she operated on a thorn from her paw at the beginning of the summer 🙏🙏I recommend them 🫶🫶

My dog ​​had a cyst in his leg, the treatment cost a hundred thousand forints, and it included surgery, but they couldn't remove the cyst. After the surgery, a hard lump formed on my dog's leg, I went back and asked them to try to remove the cyst, but they didn't. They reassured me that it was just an air bubble, and the doctor pricked it with a needle, which caused blood to flow, which is how I knew it wasn't an air bubble. The last time they sent me for an ultrasound, saying that they would see where the cyst was. Of course, I didn't go, because it would have been just a cashier's check, and you can't see things with an ultrasound. Instead, I went to the nearby vet's office, and they removed the cyst in a few minutes, which they couldn't do in three weeks at this office. Béla, the owner, yelled at me once because my dog ​​vomited on the DIRTY carpet in the waiting room. Poor thing was struggling with an upset stomach at the time.
I regret every minute I spent here and every forint I paid here. I still haven't received the bill for the surgery, even though I asked for it several times.

Recommendation
I was completely satisfied, they were incredibly attentive, kind and knowledgeable.
I received detailed information about everything and I felt that my dog ​​was in the best hands.
I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable veterinary care at a completely fair price!

Precise, competent, kind team! I am extremely satisfied!

A wonderful clinic with friendly doctors and professional assistance in English. We arrived in Budapest as tourists and our dog stopped eating. Without a reservation, we rushed to the clinic with our Samoyed. They examined us, listened carefully to our complaints, took our temperature, and prescribed medication, which made our dog feel much better. Everything went very smoothly and easily, without the stress of an appointment in an unfamiliar city and in another language. A huge thank you to Dr. Gabriella Szucs and the entire clinic team!

Unfortunately, we had a very bad experience with the clinic.
Our dog showed symptoms of babesiosis, but the tests did not rule out this disease, they went in a different direction. They asked for a blood test the next day, with results the same day, but when it arrived, the doctor could not diagnose babesiosis either. Three days later we lost our dog. 💔At that time, he was already treated at the animal hospital, but they said that unfortunately babesiosis was recognized too late.
I think that if the possibility of babesiosis had been taken into account in time, maybe it could have turned out differently. For us, this is a huge loss and disappointment.
We are sharing all this so that other owners can be more careful and not find themselves in a similar situation.

We went to Dr. Méhes's office based on a recommendation. He immediately recognized the problem in my then-month-old Jack Russell terrier, and after his life-saving surgery at the University, he is completely healthy. This happened 5 years ago, and since then there has been no question where we will take not only him, but also our other dogs.
Every doctor working there does his job with heart and soul - since then we have been to Dr. Sarkadi and Dr. Méri, and we have always met with maximum attention and expertise.
We turn to them with confidence in any situation, because we know that our pets are in good hands. We have always felt that the prices are fair, especially compared to the care and expertise we receive in return. For someone who truly loves their animals, the most important thing is that they are in good hands.
In the meantime, we have moved to the countryside, but we continue to go back to them - even the one-hour trip is worth it to be sure that they are in the best hands! I can only recommend them, from the bottom of my heart.

I moved to Budapest for work and brought my little dog with me. I was very worried and also scared because I still don't speak the language; currently I can only communicate in English. It has been really difficult for me, but I was recommended to a clinic, and Dr. Szucs was wonderful with me. The stress of having to change veterinarians is horrible, but the communication was clear; she explained everything in detail and even helped by sending me a summary of what we discussed during the appointment. It was incredible work, and I’m so grateful to her for making my experience so pleasant.
